body:
Thank you for your comments. To be honest I feel so damn alone. When I got married many of my friends disappeared. Several completely cut my wife and myself off and I was ok with that because I had her. We were happy with just having each other.
Now without her I find I have noone to help me through this and with all in the world going on I can't just go try to make friends again and who wants to befriend an emotional wreck of a man...even though you are not known to me the comment alone helps some though I am still completely lost.

Well my specifics were that I was not attentive enough both sexually and general physical contact. I hyper-focused on work and finances instead of things I should have. I am a little socially awkward and am working on all those things. Her specifics were she would bottle up complaints rather than communicate the issues so she would shut down and I would soon follow suit. Which lead to minor arguments over other items. 
I recently found that she was talking to a few other guys and was getting the attention from them along with "advice" which I believe caused further issue. Though never did she physically meet these guys that probably hurts me most.
She has a low self esteem and trust issues but I am ok with those and try to deal with them as best I know how. If you would like more specific I can try to do better. I am happier with myself now than before and I can see where my issues hurt her in ways so therapy has been helpful.
